summary: Backend-only independent confirmation of the deployed-preview readiness contract (owner-admin-pin-v4) and regression re-run of tests/shared_v1. All 5 requested backend GET/POST checks passed against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://silver-checkout-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Regression suite: 108 passed on retry (initial run had 1 flaky failure that passed in isolation and passed on full re-run).

minor.issue: Flaky in full-suite run: failed once (107/108), passed in isolation and passed on the very next full-suite retry (108/108). Suggests shared-state / ordering sensitivity across the isolated ASGI copy at /root/yash-contract.

action_items: Investigate flakiness of test_request_resolution_reopen_idempotency_history_and_today_metrics_cohort (likely shared Mongo/state carry-over between prior test cases in same file when run in order; passes in isolation and 108/108 on re-run).
critical_code_review_comments: parse_owner_admin() (readiness.py L30-39) correctly returns {'reported': False} when app_flows missing or 'ready' is not a bool; state is None unless in {created,promoted,already_admin}; phone_suffix is None unless exactly 4 digits (re.fullmatch [0-9]{4}). Confirmed read-only and never used to gate flows.

compute() (L130-147) only adds issues from parse_health's issues dict for staff/enrollment/deletion. owner_admin is placed under upstream and is never appended into flows[name]['issues']. Website flow readiness cannot be blocked by owner_admin state. Contract holds.

health_report() surfaces upstream.owner_admin via **snapshot spread; response body did NOT contain canonical id 'bcdf18c9' nor any 32+ char secret-looking token (only build strings and doc field names were >32 chars). Good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview /api/health/ready is expected to return HTTP 503 due to placeholder ENROLLMENT_INTEGRATION_KEY & STAFF_SERVICE_KEY (by design). upstream.owner_admin observed as {reported:true, ready:true, issues:[], state:'promoted', phone_suffix:'3334'} against production app (shared-v1-review-fonts-2026-09-12). NEVER call any /send-otp or /verify-otp with a valid Origin on the preview or on production domains; and never use phone 9999813334. Full pytest suite tests/shared_v1 = 108 tests; one test occasionally flakes in full-suite ordering but passes on retry.
rca of the issue: N/A — no real issues. Flaky pytest observation was not reproducible in isolation or on retry.
